parrafo.en: Diosdersy Cleaning Services treats homes and businesses across Ocala to deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning and post-construction cleanup. A Latina women-owned business with over 10 years of hands-on experience, backed by the 5.0 rating our customers left on Google.

parrafo_1.es: Diosdersy Cleaning Services es un negocio de limpieza latino y liderado por mujeres con base en Ocala, FL, con más de 10 años de experiencia limpiando casas y negocios. Llegamos con nuestro propio equipo y productos de limpieza, y no nos vamos hasta que cada rincón quede impecable.
parrafo_1.en: Diosdersy Cleaning Services is a Latina women-owned cleaning business based in Ocala, FL, with over 10 years of hands-on experience cleaning homes and businesses. We arrive with our own equipment and cleaning products, and we do not leave until every corner is spotless.

parrafo_2.es: Esa dedicación sostiene la calificación de 5.0 en Google, con 26 reseñas de clientes reales, incluyendo agentes inmobiliarios que confían en nosotros para dejar las casas listas antes de una venta.
parrafo_2.en: That dedication holds up the 5.0 rating on Google, backed by 26 reviews from real customers, including real estate agents who trust us to get homes ready before a sale.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué necesitas limpiar (casa, oficina, mudanza o post-construcción) al (352) 653-9291 y te damos un estimado.
texto.en: Tell us what needs cleaning, whether a home, office, move or post-construction job, at (352) 653-9291 and we will give you an estimate.

texto.es: Acordamos día y hora según el tamaño y estado del espacio.
texto.en: We set a day and time based on the size and condition of the space.

texto.es: Llegamos con nuestro propio equipo y productos de limpieza, listos para trabajar sin pausas.
texto.en: We arrive with our own cleaning equipment and products, ready to work start to finish without breaks.

texto.es: Revisamos cada espacio contigo antes de irnos. Muchos clientes nos vuelven a llamar para el próximo servicio.
texto.en: We walk through every space with you before we leave. Many clients call us back for the next service.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el tamaño y el estado del espacio. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso. También ofrecemos lavado a presión (pressure washing).
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the size and condition of the space. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached. We also offer pressure washing.

texto.es: Cocinas, baños, alfombras y cada superficie de tu casa, con nuestro propio equipo y productos.
texto.en: Kitchens, bathrooms, carpets and every surface in your home, with our own equipment and products.

texto.es: Dejamos la propiedad lista para entrega o venta. Trabajamos con agentes inmobiliarios de Ocala.
texto.en: We get the property ready for handover or sale. We work with real estate agents across Ocala.

texto.es: Retiramos polvo y residuos de obra para que una casa nueva o remodelada quede lista para habitar.
texto.en: We clear construction dust and debris so a new or remodeled home is ready to move into.

texto.es: Mantenimiento de limpieza para oficinas y espacios comerciales en Ocala y alrededores.
texto.en: Cleaning maintenance for offices and commercial spaces around Ocala and the surrounding area.

pie.es: Traemos nuestro propio equipo y productos de limpieza a cada trabajo, adaptándonos si tienes alergias o preferencias.
pie.en: We bring our own cleaning equipment and products to every job, and we work around allergies or product preferences.

items.quote: If you are looking for a cleaning company that will truly do what you hired them to do, this is the company. I'm a Realtor, and sometimes we have to help clients get their homes ready to sell, and a good cleaning is one of those things. You will be impressed, not only by the spotless job that they do, but their professionalism!!!!

Diorsdery cleaning service has been providing me with exceptional cleaning for my home. From deep cleaning carpets and bathrooms, they are very thorough, they have exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend if you're looking for reliable and high-quality cleaning!
Would highly recommend this cleaning service. I myself am a realtor and they offer a referral programs for us realtors and this was just amazing. She did so good and I will definitely use her again.
